arguments.code:
import math

def pump_efficiency(flow_m3_h: float, head_m: float, density_kg_m3: float, power_kw: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Calculate hydraulic power and pump efficiency adhering to API 610."""
    q = flow_m3_h / 3600.0
    g = 9.81
    p_hyd_kw = (density_kg_m3 * g * q * head_m) / 1000.0
    eff = p_hyd_kw / power_kw
    return p_hyd_kw, eff

# Boundary & Safety Test Run
hyd_kw, eff = pump_efficiency(flow_m3_h=150.0, head_m=45.0, density_kg_m3=850.0, power_kw=22.0)
print(f'Hydraulic Power: {hyd_kw:.2f} kW | Efficiency: {eff*100:.2f}%')
assert 0.0 < eff < 1.0, 'Efficiency out of physical bounds'
print('VERIFICATION PASSED: API 610 boundary conditions valid.')
